verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Notion feature for exporting all workspace data in open formats such as Markdown, HTML or CSV. The REST API and MCP read access ("read... nearly everything") are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a note and workspace tool, so the absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
